episodes.title: AI’s doomer cult
episodes.description: This week we dust off our corkboard and thread to connect the dots between problematic Silicon Valley ideologies and the doomsday AI talking points that have been gripping the world of late. Yes, this explanation of a cult-like culture that has infiltrated the highest echelons of business and government is going to sound like a conspiracy theory, but bear with us as we unpack the history of 'superintelligence' fantasies (and nightmares) in this bumper episode, revealing how every scary story about AI lately stems from known issues and very human failings. *** Good things we recommend *** >> Watch the Ghost in the Machine documentary >> Set up a daily games challenge with family and friends with PlayUs on Android or iOS >> Let us know what you think of the pod (and if you want an FTS PlayUs group) via fortechssakepod@gmail.com >> Better yet, rate, review and share the podcast with anyone you think might like it *** More from us *** Kelly's Substack: kellysrubbish.substack.com FTS blog: for-techs-sake.ghost.io FTS TikTok: fortechssakepod FTS Instagram: fortechssakepod FTS Bluesky: fortechssakepod.bsky.social FTS UpScrolled: fortechssakepod Hosted on Acast.
